title: [PowerToys Run][Unit Converter] Degree unit parsing fails under Turkish culture

status.label: Existing fix in review
status.detail: Open PR #50414 implements the exact invariant-casing change and Turkish-culture regression test described in the issue.

summary: Uppercase CELSIUS and FAHRENHEIT fail under tr-TR because DegreePrefixer uses current-culture lowercasing for fixed English parser tokens.
next_action: Review the linked fix PR #50414; do not start a competing issue design.

judgment.rationale: The issue is already covered by the reporter's open pull request #50414, whose two-file patch makes the proposed invariant-casing change and adds the specified Turkish-culture regression test.
evidence: The issue identifies both affected files, the CultureInfo.CurrentCulture call in DegreePrefixer, the tr-TR casing failure, and the intended ToLowerInvariant fix.
The issue timeline links open PR #50414, "[PTRun][UnitConverter] Use invariant casing for degree unit tokens."
PR #50414 changes both DegreePrefixer calls from ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) to ToLowerInvariant().
PR #50414 adds PrefixesDegreesWithTurkishCulture, which sets tr-TR, verifies CELSIUS and FAHRENHEIT normalize to the UnitsNet names, and restores the original culture.
judgment.recommended_action: Route maintainer effort to review and validate PR #50414.

fix_assessment.rationale: Open PR #50414 implements the exact source and regression-test changes supported by this issue.

issue_context.summary: The reporter provided a precise culture-dependent parser regression, exact source and test locations, and an implementation that is now available for review in a linked pull request.
known_information: The issue reproduces on a PowerToys main-branch build under the tr-TR culture with uppercase temperature names.
DegreePrefixer currently normalizes fixed English tokens with CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.
Under tr-TR, uppercase I lowercases to dotless i, so CELSIUS and FAHRENHEIT do not match the expected fixed tokens.
PR #50414 is open, changes the two casing calls to ToLowerInvariant, and adds a culture-scoped MSTest regression.
inferences: The linked patch should resolve the reported degree-name parsing failure without changing culture-aware numeric parsing or other Unit Converter behavior.
issue_context.analysis: The issue's root cause, minimal code change, and test are independently corroborated by the linked PR diff. Creating another design would duplicate implementation already awaiting review.
initial_investigation: Reviewed src/modules/launcher/Plugins/Community.PowerToys.Run.Plugin.UnitConverter/InputInterpreter.cs and confirmed both DegreePrefixer switches use current-culture lowercasing.
Reviewed InputInterpreterTests.cs and confirmed the pre-existing degree tests were not scoped to Turkish culture.
Reviewed PR #50414 and its complete two-file diff; it makes the exact invariant-casing replacement and adds the reported regression test.
Checked the issue timeline, which links #50414 as the active public fix.

verify: Review and run the Unit Converter test coverage in PR #50414 on a Windows build environment.
Confirm a tr-TR query using uppercase CELSIUS and FAHRENHEIT resolves to DegreeCelsius and DegreeFahrenheit.
